act: Bundesgesetz über Barrierefreiheitsanforderungen für Produkte und Dienstleistungen (Barrierefreiheitsgesetz – BaFG)
act_en: Federal Act on accessibility requirements for products and services (Accessibility Act – BaFG)
authority_en: Federal Office for Social Affairs and Disability (Sozialministeriumservice)
penalty_summary: Offering or providing a service contrary to § 14(1) is punishable by up to EUR 80,000 (up to EUR 50,000 for SMEs); failing to draw up the Annex 3 information up to EUR 40,000 (EUR 25,000 for SMEs); failing to provide/keep the information, notify non-conformity or cooperate up to EUR 16,000.
information_where: general terms and conditions or a similar document
microenterprise_exemption: § 6(1) BaFG (microenterprises offering or providing services are exempt from the § 4(3) requirements and all related obligations); definition § 3 Z 19

act: Loi du 5 novembre 2023 modifiant plusieurs livres du Code de droit économique et la loi du 2 août 2002 relative à la surveillance du secteur financier et aux services financiers en vue de la transposition partielle de la directive (UE) 2019/882 du Parlement européen et du Conseil du 17 avril 2019 relative aux exigences en matière d'accessibilité applicables aux produits et services, pour ce qui concerne certains services
act_en: Act of 5 November 2023 amending several books of the Code of Economic Law and the Act of 2 August 2002 on the supervision of the financial sector and financial services, for the partial transposition of Directive (EU) 2019/882 on accessibility requirements for products and services, as regards certain services
authority: SPF Economie, P.M.E., Classes moyennes et Énergie – Direction générale de l'Inspection économique
authority_en: FPS Economy, SMEs, Self-employed and Energy – Directorate-General Economic Inspection
penalty_type: criminal fine (sanction de niveau 2 / niveau 3), may be settled by administrative fine
penalty_summary: Breaches of art. VIII.59–VIII.62 (accessibility requirements, information, conformity procedures, disproportionate-burden assessment) are punished with a level-2 sanction (EUR 26–10,000 or 4% of annual turnover if higher), or level 3 in bad faith (EUR 26–25,000 or 6% of annual turnover if higher); the court may add corrective measures.
microenterprise_exemption: Art. 40 of the Act of 5 November 2023: undertakings with fewer than 10 employees and annual turnover or balance sheet total ≤ EUR 2,000,000 are excluded from the Act until 28 June 2030 (temporary); CDE art. VIII.59 §2 allows the King to exclude micro-enterprises from some or all requirements

act: Ο περί της Προσβασιμότητας Προϊόντων και Υπηρεσιών Νόμος του 2024, Ν. 57(Ι)/2024
act_en: Accessibility of Products and Services Law of 2024, L. 57(I)/2024
penalty_type: administrative fine; also a criminal offence
penalty_summary: Administrative fine up to EUR 10,000 (EUR 20,000 for a repeat breach) plus up to EUR 500 per day while it continues; as a criminal offence up to EUR 20,000 and/or 2 years (repeat: EUR 30,000 and/or 3 years).

act: Zákon č. 424/2023 Sb., o požadavcích na přístupnost některých výrobků a služeb
act_en: Act No. 424/2023 Coll. on accessibility requirements for certain products and services
penalty_summary: Up to CZK 10,000,000 for a service that does not meet the requirements, is not fixed, or ignores ordered measures; lower caps (CZK 5M / 2M / 1M) for other service offences, CZK 1M for not publishing the § 14 information.
information_where: general terms or equivalent document (also in audio form on request)

act: Lov nr. 801 af 7. juni 2022 om tilgængelighedskrav for produkter og tjenester
act_en: Act No. 801 of 7 June 2022 on accessibility requirements for products and services
penalty_summary: Breaches, including the service provider's information duty, are punishable by a fine set by the courts; companies can be held liable. The act sets no amount.
information_where: general terms or equivalent document, in writing and orally

act: Laki digitaalisten palvelujen tarjoamisesta (306/2019), 3 a luku
act_en: Act on the Provision of Digital Services (306/2019), chapter 3 a, added by Act 104/2023
penalty_summary: No fines: Traficom can order the service to be fixed within a reasonable time and back the order with a conditional fine (uhkasakko).
information_where: stand-alone accessibility statement (saavutettavuusseloste); feedback answered within 2 weeks

act: LOI n° 2023-171 du 9 mars 2023 portant diverses dispositions d'adaptation au droit de l'Union européenne dans les domaines de l'économie, de la santé, du travail, des transports et de l'agriculture (art. 16)
act_en: Law No. 2023-171 of 9 March 2023 laying down various provisions adapting to European Union law in the fields of the economy, health, labour, transport and agriculture (Article 16)
authority: Direction générale de la concurrence, de la consommation et de la répression des fraudes (DGCCRF)
authority_en: Directorate-General for Competition Policy, Consumer Affairs and Fraud Control
penalty_summary: Each failure by a service provider (non-compliant service, missing/unpublished accessibility information, not informing authorities, not providing compliance information on request) is a 5th-class contravention: up to EUR 1,500 for a natural person and EUR 7,500 for a legal person per offence; repeat offences up to EUR 3,000 / EUR 15,000.
microenterprise_exemption: Code de la consommation art. L. 412-13 I, last paragraph (fewer than 10 persons and turnover or balance sheet ≤ EUR 2 million: exempt from the requirements and all related obligations)

act: Gesetz zur Umsetzung der Richtlinie (EU) 2019/882 des Europäischen Parlaments und des Rates über die Barrierefreiheitsanforderungen für Produkte und Dienstleistungen (Barrierefreiheitsstärkungsgesetz – BFSG)
act_en: Act implementing Directive (EU) 2019/882 of the European Parliament and of the Council on the accessibility requirements for products and services (Accessibility Strengthening Act – BFSG)
authority: Marktüberwachungsstelle der Länder für die Barrierefreiheit von Produkten und Dienstleistungen (MLBF AöR), Magdeburg
authority_en: Market Surveillance Authority of the Länder for the Accessibility of Products and Services (MLBF), Magdeburg
penalty_summary: Offering or providing an e-commerce service contrary to § 14(1) (not meeting the BFSGV requirements, or without the Annex 3 information made accessible to the public) is a regulatory offence punishable by a fine of up to EUR 100,000; other service-provider offences (e.g. failing to notify non-conformity under § 14(4) or to give information to the authority under § 14(5)) up to EUR 10,000.
information_where: general terms and conditions (Allgemeine Geschäftsbedingungen) or in another clearly perceptible manner
microenterprise_exemption: § 3(3) BFSG (requirements of § 3(1) do not apply to microenterprises offering or providing services); definition § 2 Nr. 17 BFSG (<10 persons and annual turnover or balance sheet total ≤ EUR 2 million)

penalty_summary: Administrative sanctions under the principle of proportionality; the act sets no amount for services (amounts are delegated to a presidential decree for products only).

act: 2022. évi XVII. törvény a termékekre és a szolgáltatásokra vonatkozó akadálymentességi követelményeknek való megfelelés általános szabályairól (Aktv.)
act_en: Act XVII of 2022 on the general rules for compliance with accessibility requirements for products and services
authority_en: consumer protection authority (Budapest and county government offices)
penalty_summary: The authority first warns and agrees a deadline; a fine follows only if the business does not cooperate or fix. From HUF 15,000; up to HUF 500,000 for most businesses; for large non-SME businesses above HUF 100M turnover up to 5% of turnover, max HUF 500M.

act: Decreto legislativo 27 maggio 2022, n. 82 — Attuazione della direttiva (UE) 2019/882 del Parlamento europeo e del Consiglio, del 17 aprile 2019, sui requisiti di accessibilità dei prodotti e dei servizi
act_en: Legislative Decree No. 82 of 27 May 2022 — Implementation of Directive (EU) 2019/882 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 17 April 2019 on the accessibility requirements for products and services
penalty_summary: A service provider that breaches the accessibility requirements or its service-provider obligations (art. 3, art. 12 c. 1–4) faces an administrative fine of EUR 5,000–40,000, graded by the extent of non-conformity and number of users affected; failure to comply with AgID corrective orders or to cooperate: EUR 2,500–30,000; providers with average turnover above EUR 500 million (L. 4/2004 art. 3 c. 1-bis) are in any case subject to the L. 4/2004 sanction of up to 5% of turnover.
microenterprise_exemption: D.Lgs. 82/2022 art. 3, comma 3 (definition art. 2 lett. bb): fewer than 10 persons and turnover or balance sheet ≤ EUR 2 million)

act: Wet van 8 april 2024 tot wijziging van diverse wetten ter implementatie van Richtlijn (EU) 2019/882 (Implementatiewet toegankelijkheidsvoorschriften producten en diensten)
act_en: Act of 8 April 2024 amending various acts to implement Directive (EU) 2019/882 (Accessibility Requirements for Products and Services Implementation Act)
authority_en: Netherlands Authority for Consumers and Markets (ACM)
penalty_type: administrative fine and/or periodic penalty payment (last onder dwangsom)
penalty_summary: Breach of BW 6:230fb (via art. 8.15 Whc) is an infringement for which the ACM may impose an order subject to periodic penalty or an administrative fine of up to EUR 900,000 or, if higher, 1% of the offender's turnover (doubled for a repeat offence within five years).
information_where: statute: information per Annex V of Directive (EU) 2019/882 (i.e. general terms and conditions or equivalent document); ACM guidance: an accessibility statement (verklaring) on the website/app, easy to find, itself accessible, in written and oral form
microenterprise_exemption: BW 6:230fc(1) (art. 230fb does not apply to undertakings with fewer than 10 employees and annual turnover or balance sheet total ≤ EUR 2 million)

act: Ustawa z dnia 26 kwietnia 2024 r. o zapewnianiu spełniania wymagań dostępności niektórych produktów i usług przez podmioty gospodarcze
act_en: Act of 26 April 2024 on ensuring compliance with accessibility requirements of certain products and services by economic operators
authority: Minister właściwy do spraw informatyzacji (Minister Cyfryzacji); ponadto Prezes Zarządu PFRON (kontrola, postępowania, kary)
authority_en: Minister responsible for computerisation (Minister of Digital Affairs); in addition the President of the Management Board of the State Fund for Rehabilitation of Disabled Persons (PFRON) can inspect and fine
penalty_summary: A service provider that fails to ensure accessibility, to carry out the conformity assessment, to inform the authority of non-compliance, or to supply information on request can be fined up to ten times the average monthly wage in the national economy for the previous year, but not more than 10% of the previous year's turnover.
information_where: terms of service (regulamin) or other equivalent document

act_en: Decree-Law No. 82/2022 of 6 December, transposing Directive (EU) 2019/882
penalty_summary: For legal persons: EUR 12,000–24,000 for a grave offence, from EUR 24,000 up to the general statutory ceiling for a very grave one (non-compliant service = very grave); halved limits for negligence; convictions are published.
information_where: general terms or equivalent document, in writing and orally

act: Legea nr. 232/2022 privind cerințele de accesibilitate aplicabile produselor și serviciilor
act_en: Law No. 232/2022 on accessibility requirements for products and services
penalty_summary: For service providers RON 5,000–15,000 depending on the breach (RON 7,000–15,000 for the information duties); complementary measures possible.
information_where: general terms or equivalent document, in writing and orally

act: Ley 11/2023, de 8 de mayo, de trasposición de Directivas de la Unión Europea en materia de accesibilidad de determinados productos y servicios, migración de personas altamente cualificadas, tributaria y digitalización de actuaciones notariales y registrales; y por la que se modifica la Ley 12/2011, de 27 de mayo, sobre responsabilidad civil por daños nucleares o producidos por materiales radiactivos (título I)
act_en: Law 11/2023 of 8 May transposing European Union Directives on the accessibility of certain products and services, migration of highly qualified persons, taxation and digitalisation of notarial and registry procedures; and amending Law 12/2011 of 27 May on civil liability for nuclear damage or damage caused by radioactive materials (Title I)
authority: Autoridades de vigilancia designadas por las comunidades autónomas y las ciudades de Ceuta y Melilla; en su defecto, la Unidad técnica de apoyo y coordinación (UTAC), Dirección General de Derechos de las Personas con Discapacidad
authority_en: Surveillance authorities designated by each autonomous community (and Ceuta/Melilla); where none is designated, the Technical Support and Coordination Unit (UTAC) of the Directorate-General for the Rights of Persons with Disabilities
penalty_summary: Ley 11/2023 sets no fines of its own: breaches are punished under the applicable sectoral regime and, failing that, under Title III of RDL 1/2013, where failure to meet accessibility requirements is a serious infringement (EUR 30,001–90,000 at State level) or, where it prevents free access and use, a very serious one (up to EUR 1,000,000); autonomous communities type the infringements in their own legislation.

act: Lag (2023:254) om vissa produkters och tjänsters tillgänglighet
act_en: Act (2023:254) on the accessibility of certain products and services
penalty_summary: A sanction fee of SEK 10,000 to 10,000,000; none in minor cases. Orders may carry a conditional fine (vite).
